tagline: Closing the distance between real skills and real opportunity

country.pickerSubtitle: Unmapped Kairos reconfigures itself for your local labor market, education system, currency, and language. Pick where you live.

intake.title: Tell us what you can do
intake.subtitle: Your skills are real even if no one wrote them down. We'll help you put them on paper — and you stay in charge of every word.
intake.educationPrompt: What's the highest level of education you completed?
intake.credentialPrompt: Did you receive a specific certificate or diploma?
intake.languagesPrompt: Which languages can you use at work?
intake.experiencePrompt: Tell us about things you can do — work you've done for money, things you've taught yourself, projects you've built.
intake.experiencePlaceholder: e.g. I've fixed phones for 5 years. I learned Python from YouTube. I run a small WhatsApp business.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.subtitle: This is yours. Edit anything that doesn't sound right. Export it as a JSON passport you can take anywhere.

readiness.title: AI readiness
readiness.subtitle: An honest look at which parts of your work are at automation risk in {country}, and what skills are durable.
readiness.calibrationBody: Frey-Osborne automation scores were dampened by {alphaPct}% to reflect the country's digital infrastructure score of {infra}. Routine task share added {betaPct}% uplift.
readiness.adjacentSkillsHeading: Adjacent durable skills you could reach

opportunities.title: Opportunities you can reach
opportunities.subtitle: Honest matches based on what you can do today and what {country}'s labor market actually pays and hires.
opportunities.noMatches: We couldn't find honest matches yet — try adding a few more skills to your profile.

dashboard.subtitle: Aggregate signals on the youth labor market. Built for program officers, not just dashboards.
